ContactViewer.title: ContactViewer
ContactViewer.description: Records and logs of authenticated users who have unlocked contact coordinates

id.description: Unique identifier of the log entry

name.description: Full name of the verified viewer

email.description: E-mail coordinates of the logged user

loginType.description: The authentication provider type used (e.g., Google or Email Password)

date.description: ISO 8601 string timestamp representing verification time

ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: A direct message or inquiry submitted by visitors using the secure contact form

name.description: Name of the sender dispatching the message

/contactViewers/{viewerId}.description: Collection tracking all authorized sessions of viewers on the portfolio contact coordinates

/contacts/{contactId}.description: Collection storing all submitted correspondence from the dashboard contact grid
